candidates.title: HBFlex: A Flexible Memory System for Bridging Fine-Grained LLM States and Coarse-Grained HBF Parallel Execution
candidates.reason: Full-HBF memory system for LLM serving; directly studies KV placement, read/write interference, lifetime-aware reclamation, and reports up to 1.58x throughput over FlashAccel and 3.30x over H3. Strong fit to SSD/flash and hierarchical-memory lineage.

candidates.title: LLM Inference in a Flash!
candidates.reason: Compute-in-Flash LLM inference with integer-only quantization and dictionary-based KV compression; targets both model weights and KV state near flash and reports 15x reduction in dynamic KV traffic. Directly relevant to SSD/near-storage inference.

candidates.title: PipeSwift: Revisiting Pipeline Parallelism for Large-Scale Completion-Oriented Agentic Serving
candidates.reason: Agentic-serving systems work that revisits pipeline parallelism under completion-time-oriented workloads; appears to provide an open-source runtime and at-scale systems evaluation, making it a strong serving/scheduling candidate.

candidates.title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
candidates.reason: MLX inference runtime combining compressed KV execution, phase-aware component swapping, and state-preserving transitions on a 24 GiB laptop; reports 6.93x larger completed single-request context than its mlx-vlm baseline and concrete end-to-end throughput/memory measurements.
